text:
Hi Dillon, 
Apologies for the delay here! It seems your first email got caught in our spam folder. 
I am happy to report that we currently have availability for dinner in our Library on both June 3rd and 5th. We do also have availability for dinner in our Shiraga Room on June 3rd if your guest count is flexible! 
The Library will comfortably accommodate your party of 10-15 guests on one long table. This space can accommodate a standing cocktail reception prior to dinner for parties of up to 14 guests, and a seated one for parties of 15. On the 3rd, the Library holds
an F&B minimum of $3,250, excluding taxes and fees, with a $500 room rental fee. On the 5th, the room rental fee stays the same, though the F&B minimum is slightly higher at $3,750. 
The Library is a beautiful light-filled space with large windows and a fireplace. This room is located at the front of the restaurant before entering our foyer, just outside the main doors. One wall is curtained and opens up to the foyer. If the curtain is
left open, this room can be considered an indoor/outdoor space. (Please note The Library does not allow presentation via projection or flat screen due to windows looking into the lounge). 
Alternatively, The Shiraga Room can accommodate parties of up to 12 guests for a fully seated cocktail reception and dinner on one long table. On the 3rd, this space holds an F&B minimum of $2,750, excluding taxes and fees, with a $300 room rental fee. This
fully private room has a separate door and no windows, perfect for an intimate dinner.
I have attached our Private Dining Guide for your consideration which holds further details. Please let me know if I can assist with any questions or if you would like to move forward with a contract: this email does not stand as a reservation or a hold.

subject: Re: Hello from James @ Encord | Multimodal Annotation
text:
Hi James,

Thanks for your response. It will be great to hear your experience on
e-commerce uses cases based on your existing partnerships. Have blocked
your calendar at 4 pm on 8th May, also below are points/capabilities we
want to discuss during our connect.

We are looking for a platform that can help us meet our labelling
requirements for different data types, such as images, videos, audio, and
text. Below is a list of features we are looking for in each data type.

Data Types Features Required
Image Bounding boxes, polygons, semantic segmentation, instance
segmentation, keypoint annotation, polylines, cuboids
Video Object tracking (across frames), event tagging, temporal segmentation
Text Named entity recognition (NER), part-of-speech (POS) tagging,
sentiment analysis, text classification, relationship extraction.
Audio  Transcription, speaker diarization, event tagging

We would also want to understand how customizable the platform is in terms
of UI, Process flow, and integration with LLM models, if the platform
supports model-assisted labelling, reporting, and analytics capabilities,
and also discuss the pricing structure.
